slides.texte_overlay:
Why every man should
learn to dance a little
It kills awkwardness at weddings and parties. Knowing a few simple steps means you join in instead of standing at the edge.
It builds real confidence. Moving in front of others is scary at first. Once you do it, many other fears feel smaller.
It's great exercise. An hour of dancing works your legs, core and cardio while feeling more like fun than training.
It improves coordination and rhythm. Useful in sports, on stage and anywhere you need to move with control. Rhythm helps everywhere.
Before: I always stayed by the bar at weddings. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I said yes to a dance class too.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I always stayed by the bar at weddings. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I said yes to a dance class too.

slides.texte_overlay: It's a great way to meet people. Dance classes are social, friendly and full of people who want to learn too.
You don't need to be good. Enjoying yourself is enough. People remember your energy, not your technique. Just enjoy it.
